thread:
Maya CSM: Heads up — BeaconFoods account health just slid. 14d active seats down ~42% and their renewal is in ~36 days. New Head of Data (Eva Park) started last week and we spotted a ScoutAI pilot launch. Need quick triage.

jonathan_csm: Can you drop the numbers and any signal of churn reason? link to dashboard? :eyes:

Maya CSM: quick snapshot — dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/beaconfoods/health :
```
14d active seats: 12 -> 7
avg tokens/day: 45k -> 18k
most active routes: ingestion (fell off), search, analytics
key users: ingest-team lead left 10d ago
```
:warning: also saw a public job post that suggests ScoutAI pilot started ~3 days ago.

liam_sales: pinging sales lead @liam — did we hand any commercial invites or on-prem talks?

liam_sales: We ran a scoping call 2 weeks ago. They asked about on-prem and fine-tuning access. ScoutAI offered a hosted trial with custom NER yesterday. I have a neutral demo scheduled Friday but we should move fast.

sophia_csm: Proposed immediate play: 1) Rapid win outreach to Eva + current champions (15m) 2) Offer a 60-day dedicated trial with performance guardrails 3) One-sheet comparing latency/cost and on-prem options vs ScoutAI. Also schedule an exec QBR invite.

maya_csm: I'll request intro to Eva. Can someone prepare the one-sheet? Need concrete numbers for ingestion pipeline (latency, tokens, ops cost).

ops_bot: Alert — renewal window: 36 days. health_score: 82 -> 45 in last 14d. flagged: usage_drop, stakeholder_change.

jonathan_csm: I'll pull the full usage export + recent alerts and start a churn-risk playbook. Maya, can you share last 7d logs or the minimal queries?

Maya CSM: Pasting quick CLI for export (safe token removed):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/beaconfoods/usage?range=7d&format=csv" -o beacon_7d.csv
```
I'll DM the csv to the triage thread. :pray:

liam_sales: I'll prep the commercial counter-offer if we confirm competitive features. Sophia — can you draft a 10–12 line outreach script for Eva emphasizing: on-prem option, recent perf improvements, and migration support? Keep it executive-friendly.

sophia_csm: On it. I'll loop solutions eng for parity notes — tagging @nate_eng for demo/feature clarifications.

nate_eng: happy to help. quick Q: what exact ScoutAI features are we seeing that matter?

maya_csm: They advertised "private repo fine-tune" and ~100ms reranking for ingestion pipelines. Need verification if those are demo-only claims.

jonathan_csm: Timeline proposal: materials by Thu EOD, outreach Fri AM, demo/slot Fri 3pm if they accept. Any blockers?

liam_sales: Sounds good — go ahead. I'll prepare pricing sketch for dedicated 60-day trial with SLAs.

sophia_csm: No blockers. I'll draft the script and one-sheet and post here when ready.

Maya CSM: Creating calendar invites and updating the renewal playbook now. Will post summary + next steps after the call. :memo:

jonathan_csm: Thanks — I'll attach the usage export and a short risk heatmap when ready.

Maya CSM: Thanks team — moving to action.
